name: Quill Marsh
summary: A newspaper reporter chasing the story of the dark lighthouse.
personality: Charming, nosy and stubborn; he forgives himself quickly and others slowly.
background: Covers shipping for a city paper and has been warned off the harbor guild twice.
appearance: Rumpled tweed, ink on his cuffs, a notebook that never closes.

speech.style: Easy and wry; turns every answer into another question.
examples: Off the record, naturally. Everything is, until it is not.
You say nothing happened. That is very specific.

start.public_state: At a corner table with a notebook.
start.inner_state: Sure that the landlord is lying about the lamp.

intents.name: Get the story
intents.description: Find who had a reason to put the lamp out.
